notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (analytics product) evaluating Hosted API for dev/proof-of-concept then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and EU data residency. Primary contact: CTO (I. Petrov) + Head of Product (M. Choi).

Key requirements / wants (shorthand):
- EU data residency mandatory for user-generated content and embeddings (GDPR + customer contracts). Must show tokens and embeddings never persist outside EU.
- Multi-region routing: dev traffic from US/NA ok on hosted, production must route EU traffic to eu-central (Frankfurt) with automated fallbacks to eu-west only in emergencies. Interested in weighting rules (75% EU, 25% global) and failover latency budget.
- Latency targets: 95th pct <120ms for chat short conversations (avg seq len 120 tokens), bulk embedding jobs throughput 100 qps during nightly jobs, cost sensitive for embeddings.
- Model preferences: open models preferred but want Redwood-verified perf profiles; ability to pin to quantized variants for cost.
- Security: SSO/SAML, org-level audit logs, KMS integration for encryption-at-rest, retention controls (90d default, option for 365d).
- Rollout plan: Hosted API for 6-8 week POC (dev + internal alpha), then Dedicated for production in 3-6 months with commit-based capacity.
- Quote: "We need to demonstrate EU-only residency to enterprise customers — no exceptions." (CTO)

Commercials and POC notes:
- Pricing sensitivity: wants comparison of hosted per-token vs Dedicated commit break-even for 500M tokens/month. Asked for model-level unit economics.
- POC scope: implement chat support flows (priority), embeddings for search pilot, and a reranking experiment for top-k results. POC success criteria: pass security checklist, 95th pct latency under 120ms in eu region, cost per embedding < $0.0008 (target).

Recent activity (timeline):
- 2026-01-20: Initial intro call (Marcus) — product overview, pain: unpredictable token cost and multi-region compliance.
- 2026-01-27: Discovery deep-dive (Priya + SE) — collected traffic patterns, estimated token volumes, asked for EU residency details.
- 2026-02-03: Security questionnaire submitted by Montage (answered + sent back as drive link).
- 2026-02-10: Technical demo (hosted API) with latency benchmarking (internal). Positive feedback on streaming and rollout features.
- 2026-02-15: Commercials + POC scoping call (Marcus, Priya, Elena). Agreed on 6-week hosted POC in eu-central. Fireflies: ff_3210-montage-call-2026-02-15.
- 2026-02-22: Redwood sent Dedicated sizing worksheet and draft DPA (REDW-1123 open for legal follow-up).

POC tech details / ask to SE (Priya):
- Provide region-isolation guide: how hosted ensures EU-only processing + any EU-only hardware options.
- Show routing policy config examples for multi-region traffic weighting and automated fallback (policy examples, SLOs).
- Quantization/throughput recommendation for their embedding workload to hit cost target.
- Provide sample Dedicated commit tiers estimates and break-even analysis (500M tokens/mo baseline).

Open questions from Montage:
- Does Hosted API ever touch US-hosted control plane logs that include token metadata? Need explicit statement.
- Can we get a FedRAMP-ish network topology diagram for Dedicated in EU region?
- SLA uplift options for Dedicated (p99 latency, uptime credits).

Notes on procurement timing:
- Legal cycle: 4-6 weeks after POC if POC successful.
- Procurement prefers quarterly billing but ok to consider annual if there is a discount tied to Dedicated capacity commit.

Salesplay: focus on quick wins in Hosted to validate implementation + strong documentation for EU-only residency; follow with cost model that clearly shows when Dedicated saves money and reduces latency variance.
